name: Arapahoe PSH (now Wagoner on the Creek)
headline: Brothers Redevelopment is building 60 one-bedroom permanent supportive homes at 30% AMI on S. Chambers Road in Aurora for people leaving the justice system or experiencing homelessness. It won 2025 Round One federal 9%, state and TOC credits from CHFA, and broke ground on 2026-08-25 under the name Wagoner on the Creek.
why_it_matters: It is a county-led supportive housing model: Arapahoe County picked the developer in 2022, seeded the site with ARPA money, and pairs the building with 60 project-based vouchers and on-site behavioral health care for justice-involved residents.

status.label: Under construction (groundbreaking 2026-08-25)
status.detail: Brothers Redevelopment and Arapahoe County held a groundbreaking on 2026-08-25, and trade press reported construction had started. Leasing is expected to begin in spring 2027 and opening is targeted for fall (October) 2027. No separate public record of the financing closing or the building permit was found.

next_step: Watch for the City of Aurora building permit record for 1850 S. Chambers Road and for leasing and referral announcements in spring 2027.

key_numbers.meaning: Permanent supportive housing for people experiencing homelessness, with a preference for people recently released from justice involvement in Arapahoe County.
About $16M over the 10-year credit period, plus $650,000 state credit and $78,000 TOC credit.
10 from the Aurora Housing Authority and 50 state vouchers from the Colorado Division of Housing.
As reported at the August 2026 groundbreaking, drawn from about 10 funding sources.

facts.value: 1900 S. Chambers Road, Aurora, CO 80014 in the CHFA reports; 1850 S. Chambers Road in the 2026 groundbreaking release
N, SH: new construction, supportive housing
60 total, 60 low-income; all one-bedroom, one-bath, on four floors with two elevators
Vacant 2-acre parcel on the east side of Chambers Road between Mexico and Iliff avenues, next to the Woodrim Tributary open space. Census Tract 823; not in a QCT or DDA
R-3 medium-density multifamily; 66 surface parking spaces approved
Bus stop 0.1 mile north on Chambers Road (three RTD lines); Florida Station 1.1 miles away. Bus passes are in the operating budget

AllHealth Network leads case management, behavioral health counseling, peer support and employment services, with Aurora Mental Health & Recovery and STRIDE Community Health Center. Units are furnished; amenities include a medical exam room, community kitchen and food pantry
Through Colorado's OneHome coordinated entry and referrals from the 18th Judicial District and Arapahoe County Sheriff's Office
NGBS Bronze, Energy Star appliances, photovoltaic-ready design; 10 percent accessible units
Wagoner On The Creek LLC, formed in Colorado on 2025-12-29 with its office at Brothers Redevelopment's Denver address (inferred to be the project owner from the name)

background.text: In December 2022 the Arapahoe County Commission approved a $3M plan for permanent supportive housing for justice-involved people experiencing homelessness and selected Brothers Redevelopment as developer.
Brothers acquired the site in 2023. The applicant credits Arapahoe County ARPA funds, a U.S. Bank grant and a donation from the land seller for the land purchase and predevelopment costs.

The Aurora Planning Commission unanimously approved the Site Development Plan, including parking, on 2025-01-08, and the City Council call-up period passed without referral. Neighbor comments focused on density and traffic.
Brothers held the state tax credit public hearing on 2024-11-12, reaching out to the Chambers Ridge and Woodrim Crossing HOAs.

Site costs include a retaining wall along the Woodrim Tributary, a city-required sidewalk extension and rodent and tree mitigation, estimated at $250,000 and covered by county grant or city reimbursement funds, per the applicant.
Build: slab on grade, wood frame, HardiePlank siding, four stories with two stair towers and two central elevators; services, leasing and common areas on the first floor.
The applicant said it uses the same development and finance team as its Valor on the Fax PSH project in Denver, and that the permit could issue within days of financing closing.
Brothers announced the 9% award on 2025-06-20 and named the project Wagoner on the Creek by the August 2026 groundbreaking.
An Arapahoe County Criminal Justice Planning Office study found people experiencing homelessness re-enter jail on new charges at a 46% higher rate than housed people and serve 44% longer sentences.

discrepancies.text: CHFA and Brothers' 2025 announcement give the address as 1900 S. Chambers Road, the 2026 groundbreaking release and ConnectCRE give 1850 S. Chambers Road, and two March 2025 support letters give 1700 S. Chambers Road.
CHFA and Brothers say all units serve households at or below 30% AMI, while ConnectCRE says residents will need to earn less than 60% AMI.
CBS reported in June 2024 that completion was expected in fall 2026 and Colorado Politics reported in May 2025 a planned 2026 opening, while Brothers now targets an October 2027 opening.
Colorado Politics says Arapahoe County secured $30 million for the project, while Brothers describes a $31 million total project cost funded by many partners.
